Callout.Name: Hotel Disturbance
Callout.Message: Guests fighting in a hotel corridor.
Callout.Advisory: Two involved, staff asking for attendance.

Script.Line: They put us in a room next to theirs. That is the whole problem.
Nobody has thrown a punch. It was shouting, that is all.
I am going back to my room. I am not staying in this corridor.

Lines.Approach: Two guests in the corridor and reception cannot get them to their rooms.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
